paite: Koumau kigenhoih pan nawn dek ka hi uhia? Ahihkeileh, na kiang ua piak ding hiam aw na kiang ua kipan hiam genhoihna lai, mi khenkhat a dia akiphatmoh bang in koute a ding in akiphamoh sam ding a hia?
heading: Paul Nasepna Apiangthakte

paite: Noute ka lai uh, na lungtang ua gelh, mi tengteng theih leh sim na hi uhi.
Khrist lai, kou hon gelhsak laitui a gelh hilou, Pathian hing Kha gelh hi zaw, suangpek a gelh hilou, sa lungtang pek a gelh hi zaw na hi uh chih chiantak in na taklangta uhi.
Huan Pathian lam ah huchibang muanna Khrist vang in ka nei uhi.
Bangpeuh koumau a kipan a pawt ahi chi a ngaihsun ding in koumau kia in ka chin uh ka chi kei ua; ka chintheihna uh Pathian kiang a kipan ahi zaw.
Amah mah in thukhun thak nasemte hi ding in hon chingsak a; alai thu gelh lel nasemte ding hilou in, a Kha nasemte ding in ahi zaw hi; laithu gelh lel in zaw ahihlum nak a, Kha in bel ahihhing hi.
Mosi mel avak ziak in Israel suante'n amel a-en sawt thei kei ua, huai thupina amang hiaihiai a; sihna nasepna suang a laimal gelh bawn, huchi tel a thupi a atunleh,
heading: Gospel Leh Dan Thupina Tehna

paite: Kha nasepna pen bangchi phet a thupi in atung diam aw?
Siam louh tansakna nasepna bawn athupileh diktatna nasepna athupizaw mahmah ding ahi.
Hih thupi a omsa in hiai ah zaw thupina himhim aneita ngal kei a, thupina thupizaw in akhuh tak ziak in.
Mangta hiaihiai bawn thupi a atunleh om gige ding thupi atuam in a-om zaw mahmah ding ahi.
Huan huchibang lametna ka neih ziak un hangsantak in gen ngamna ka nei uhi.
Mosi hih bang in ka hih kei ua, ama'n zaw thupina mang hiaihiai tawpna Israel suante'n a-et sawt louhna ding un maikhuhna in amai akhuh a;
alungsim uh bel hihkhauh in a-om a; tuni tanpha in Thukhun Lui asim un khuhna ngeina hawk louh in a-om gige ngal a, huai khuhna Khrist ah hihmang in a-omta hi.
Himahleh tuni tanpha in Mosi Laibu asim peuh chiang un alungtang uah khuhna a-om hi.
Himahleh alungtang uh Toupa lam angat peuh chiang un khuhna lakmang ahita ding hi.
Huan Toupa tuh huai Kha ahi a, Toupa Kha omna peuh ah noplenna a-om zel hi.
Huchi in eite zaw i vek un mai khuh lou in limlang bang a Toupa thupina tangsawnsak zel in, amah kibatpih ngeingei a om ding in hihlamdan in i om zel uhi; hiai Toupa Kha ngei a kipan i muh ahi.
